definitions.explanation: The large spotted wild cat of Africa and Asia, a strong climber that often drags its prey up into trees.

examples.english: There's a leopard up in the tree.

examples.japanese: ヒョウ{柄|がら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャツ→シャツ：01052_shatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}ている→着る：00541_kiru⟧。

ヒョウ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕留|しと}めた→仕留める：30023_shitomeru⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{運|はこ}び{上|あ}げて、ほか⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}られない→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦ようにする→ようにする：10987_younisuru⟧。
examples.english: A leopard carries the prey it has killed up into a tree so that other animals cannot take it.

notes:
Written in katakana to keep it apart from the other words read ひょう, such as ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (vote), ⟦{表|ひょう}→表：19354_hyou⟧ (table, chart) and ⟦{雹|ひょう}→雹：17632_hyou⟧ (hail); the kanji spelling is {豹|ひょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ヒョウ{柄|がら}: leopard print — the bold pattern associated in Japan with the fashion of middle-aged Osaka women (the ⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦おばちゃん→おばちゃん：10296_obachan⟧ image)
- ユキヒョウ: snow leopard
- クロヒョウ: black panther

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦チーター→チーター：32711_chiitaa⟧: cheetah — slimmer, with solid round spots and black "tear lines" on the face; the leopard's spots are rosettes
